excluded_features.vin_masked: Identifier, used only to group evaluation splits

method: 3-fold stratified grouped CV on training data selects highest average precision; separate approximately 20% grouped holdout; masked VINs never cross partitions. Final experimental artifact refit on all 500 rows.
limitations: Only 13 fraud-positive records; metrics have high uncertainty.
Dataset provenance and label verification were not provided.
Random grouped evaluation does not establish future performance.
Scores are not calibrated fraud probabilities; manual review is always required.
Historical approval is descriptive only; no approval prediction is trained.
Legacy maintenance, credit, auction and appliance datasets have no validated join key or compatible fraud target and are excluded.
